Subject: Your divorce by mutual consent matter

Dear Mr. Patil,

Thank you for meeting us on 20 November 2024 about your dispute with Sujata Gaikwad. As we understand it, the wife wants her jewellery and gifts returned.

Our advice is to list the stridhan items to be returned in the settlement deed. Please collect the list of jewellery and gifts with any receipts and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of Rs 85,70,000.

Regards,
Adv. Kunal Bhagat
